name: village_roof_hierarchy_v1
function: two-tier inhabited-house roof family with supported eaves and north landmark firewalls
construction: 4 standard roofs with matching shared gables and purlins
4 high-ridge roofs with matching shared gables and raised ridge purlins
8 linked rafter rows with 18 supported tails per house
8 linked octagonal tile-end rows with 18 tile ends per house
2 linked stepped firewall bodies and dark tile caps
2 linked asymmetric ridges terminating inside the street-facing firewall
triangle_count_method: whole-scene base mesh delta against round 03; excludes evaluated curves and Solidify
limitations: firewall cap corners, drip edges and plaster crest ornaments need final detailing
main roof surfaces do not yet model complete pantile courses
curves and modifiers are not included in the base-mesh triangle ledger
collision, navigation, LOD, UV/export audit and runtime tiers are not approved
